facts.text: I have morning meetings on Mondays and Thursdays at 9:00 am.
I need to leave the house by 8:15 am on Mondays and Thursdays to make it to my 9:00 am meetings on time.
I usually have oatmeal with fruit for breakfast around 8:15 am every day.
I usually work out in the evenings around 6:30 pm or 7:00 pm.
I like to take a relaxing walk on Sundays around 8:00 pm.
I want to block out time for TV or streaming shows in the evenings.
I want to add a bedtime routine to make sure I am getting enough sleep.
I want to adjust my bedtime routine to start earlier so I am in bed by 11:00 pm on most nights.
